native_context: DOM named-property collisions and security consumers
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: DOM named-property collisions and security consumers — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Open the sanitizer/render path and each id/name-based global, form or collection lookup used by navigation, script configuration or privileged actions.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned local page insert the allowed inert named element that collides with the actual lookup. Record the runtime type/value before and after and follow it into the security-sensitive consumer. A collision matters only if the consumer accepts the substituted object/string and changes a protected decision.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Duplicate element names without an affected consumer are an HTML correctness issue. A local variable holding a trusted constant may shadow the browser global and defeat the hypothesis.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use explicit references and type/origin validation at the affected consumer; align allowed rich content with the feature. Retest ordinary named elements and the original collision in relevant browsers.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
